title: MagFace Quality Cache Schema
description: Per-crop MagFace unified-score cache written by filter_face_crops_by_quality.py and read back for the threshold decision and demotion. A derived working file, not a FAIR-linked sidecar (the unified_score is also carried by the OFIQ quality sidecar).

face_crop_video.description: Filename of the face crop this cache scores

source_video.description: Source video the crop came from

annotated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the scores were computed

unified_score.description: MagFace unified scores: per-frame plus aggregates
